The '''Choah system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Mortex sector/Legends|Mortex sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Choah Belt/Legends|Choah Belt]].
